summary: Scope component titles are unreadable over patterned fills in dark mode and overflow circular nodes
evidence: User screenshot 2026-09-04 at 3.13.59 PM shows black SVG titles on a dark canvas with high-contrast hatch fills; renderer has no explicit SVG text fill and no bounded title layout

summary: Scope ring coordinates collapse the four-component project into a stack and dependency arrows overlap
evidence: The initial model puts the two first-ring peers at angles 0 and pi and the outer singleton at angle 0; every x coordinate is zero. Reciprocal reliance arrows share a path, and a longer edge passes through the central card.

summary: Scope library preview build confused canonical id data with Cytoscape id method
evidence: npm run build --prefix scripts/scope-preview: TypeError n.id is not a function at layout.mjs:33 while determining disconnected membership.

summary: Scope preview center control exposes a glyph rather than its purpose as its accessible name
evidence: Browser accessibility lookup for button Center gravity timed out; DOM button has title but text content is the glyph, with no aria-label.

summary: Scope library preview renders rings but no component cards or connections in user Safari screenshot
evidence: User Safari screenshot Screenshot 2026-09-04 at 3.48.46 PM shows running app with rings, heading and controls but no cards or edges. Chrome file-open still renders all four cards. Cause not yet established.

summary: The first taxonomy parity test compared a facet ID against its own prefixed ID, producing a false missing-facet result
evidence: Focused test: expected canonical-state question but received undefined; predicate was f.id === facet-prefix plus f.id instead of the frozen fixture facet.id. Other nine taxonomy tests passed.

summary: Existing Scope browser checks use page-wide Journal selectors that collide with the mounted Taxonomy panel
evidence: Chrome offline and WebKit live checks fail strict locator resolution: .empty-reading matches both Journal and Taxonomy. New taxonomy browser checks pass both engines.

summary: Overlapping status writers can lose a successful report or leave unreadable JSON
evidence: node scripts/taxonomy-risk-probes.mjs: sequential atlas-plus-mass control preserved both. Across 20 isolated overlapping trials both writers returned successfully, but 18 final records were unreadable and two were readable with a report missing; none preserved both. Schedule frequencies are one local run, not an incidence estimate.

summary: Calibration counts invalid outcome labels and silently drops torn sample rows
evidence: node scripts/taxonomy-risk-probes.mjs: one valid defect row, one not-an-outcome row and one torn JSON row produce two returned rows, labeled=2 and defectRateWithoutMisses=0.5. Only one row has a valid clean/defect label; surviving damage is not reported by readCalibrationSamples.

summary: A taxonomy candidate can require an operational question that the interview does not expose
evidence: classifyTaxonomy with authority=yes includes validator-type-checker needing signal:validates-rules, but the emitted questions omit validates-rules because representation was not answered yes. Required evidence must make its own question relevant.

summary: The added alternate-entry taxonomy test does not typecheck
evidence: npm run typecheck: test/taxonomy.test.ts:77 TS2322; heterogeneous object-array inference adds an optional undefined signal incompatible with Record<string, TaxonomyAnswer>. Runtime test passed, compiler gate correctly refused.

summary: Larger taxonomy cards overlap at some exposed concentric-layout parameters
evidence: Existing layout guard reds for root versus src/adapters at width 360, height 300, gap 48, rotation -35, sweep 200. Parameter sweep measures six overlapping pairs at gap 48 and one at gap 80. Default-layout test alone stayed green.

summary: New Scope spec fields with explicit undefined values break in-memory versus live JSON model parity
evidence: preview server test live structure follows source, spec, config and status changes failed deepStrictEqual: optional fields exist as undefined before serialization and disappear from SSE JSON

summary: verify --help starts verification rather than showing usage
evidence: node src/cli.ts verify --help emitted SERIAL ORACLES with 83 executable claims and spawned run-named-test.mjs; stopped the accidental verification run. CLI help behavior is outside this Scope presentation change.

summary: Scope startup fits the entire orbital extent and shrinks card text below a useful reading size
evidence: User reports default view hard to read; Structure centerView calls fitBounds on +/- full layout extent for startup and reset. Previous 1600px browser capture paints 420px cards at about 172px wide.

summary: React Flow fitView during Scope startup leaves the camera at its untouched origin
evidence: Chrome startup-centering guard timed out; after 500ms viewport was translate(0px, 0px) scale(1), and gravity card began at x=-210 y=-108. Existing onInit timing has not supplied the node-framing population.

summary: Larger complete card typography overflows the Harness core description area at the first compact dimensions
evidence: Chrome combined guard failed full-description fit: Harness core card-description clientHeight 323, scrollHeight 349; other three cards fit. Keeping the guard and increasing card height rather than clipping or reducing content.

summary: Mechanical subsystem migration changed lexical ordering in two golden test expectations
evidence: Full suite: 957 pass, 3 reported failures including a parent subtest aggregate. raise pair identity and trusted-decision path expectations retained old ordering after source paths moved; actual canonical sorting is correct.

summary: Scope assembly lens defaults to the parent of a composition-root center and shows only that center
evidence: scopeScene with center src, parent project ., and eight assembly children selects owner .; its pool excludes all src children

summary: Scope orbit SVG causes severe WebKit zoom-frame stalls in an isolated painting probe
evidence: Live 12-card/39-edge view at 1600x1000, DPR2, updates paused. Repeated 2.2s transform-scale sweeps: baseline p95 350ms and 234ms (18 and 21 sampled frames), no-orbits p95 33ms (115 frames), no-edges p95 238ms (24 frames). The orbit SVG is 1x1 with overflow-visible circles of radii about 2283 and 1505. Programmatic WebKit painting probe, not a native Safari input trace.

summary: New orbit component failed browser startup because the preview build requires a React namespace for JSX
evidence: WebKit offline smoke: ReferenceError Cant find variable React from orbits.jsx, whose named React imports compile successfully under the classic JSX build.

summary: Packed-consumer smoke still checks the old flat defects module address after subsystem relocation
evidence: package-smoke line 110 checks join(installed, dist, defects.js) although its message says dist/evidence/defects.js; build emits dist/evidence/defects.js. The packed consumer smoke refuses at that check.

summary: Ownership migration preserved nine rationale paragraphs but left them in the old source-root spec
evidence: why-lint --check reports nine unanchored invariants under new owners and the corresponding paragraphs under Harness core. The migration used literal paragraph.includes(invariant), so line-wrapped anchor names failed to route despite being retained by global conservation.

summary: A bounded Scope page can mislabel a canonically connected assembly as disconnected when its path leaves the page
evidence: layoutScope recomputes connectivity from displayed relations and overwrites the subject flag. A two-node page with peer ring 1, disconnected false and a withheld intermediate path becomes disconnected true.

summary: Scope guarantee text overfills the previously readable card description
evidence: WebKit browser-check failed current project descriptions fit completely ahead of taxonomy. At unchanged 0.613 scale the core body was 357px high with 529px content after inserting guarantee rows; other cards reached 613px content.
